assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: All geometry layers derive from the provisional site/key-area polygons in brief/site-package/geometry/provisional_boundaries.geojson; rectangular provisional edges do not represent parcel or road redlines.
assumptions.impact: Areas and ratios (site 11.41 km2, key areas 3.69 km2, land-use shares) must be recomputed when official polygons are published; provisional values are intake/visualization only.

assumptions.statement: Building footprints are conceptual massing clusters generated from the provisional boundary, not surveyed footprints or approved construction scale.
assumptions.impact: building_footprint_area_sqm and building_footprint_ratio describe concept massing only and cannot be used as confirmed construction scale.

assumptions.statement: The OPEN TRUNK naming, logo direction, pilgrimage landmarks, honor wall, annual event system, and all spatial/operational suggestions are concept proposals for professional teams to deepen.
assumptions.impact: None of these constitute approved government action, confirmed implementation, investment commitment, or engineering feasibility conclusions.

assumptions.statement: Evidence relies only on public or cleared sources registered in data/source_registry.json and the site package; global case studies are cited as public references only.
assumptions.impact: No non-public planning drawings, internal controls, personal privacy data, or unauthorized third-party material is claimed.
